```{r import, include=FALSE}
library(gtsummary)
library(bstfun)
library(tidyverse)
library(captioner)

# setting MSK ggplot theme and color palette
theme_set(mskRvis::theme_biostat())
mskRvis::set_msk_palette()
theme_gtsummary_compact()

# create path to secure data folder
path_data <- readr::read_lines(here::here("path_data.txt"), skip_empty_rows = TRUE)

# importing master analytic data set(s)
df_main <- readRDS(file = bstfun::path_data(path = path_data, "data.Rds"))

# import raw data source information
df_raw_data_filenames <- readRDS(
  bstfun::path_data(
    path = path_data,
    "df_raw_data_filenames.Rds"
  )
)

# Import analysis result objects here
load(bstfun::path_data(path = path_data, "020-analysis.RData"))

# List packages to cite
packages_to_cite <- c("")
```

```{r captions, include = FALSE}
## Setting up Table and Fig numberings ------------------
tbl_cap = captioner(prefix = "Table")
fig_cap = captioner(prefix = "Figure")

## table captions --------------
  tbl_cap("tbl_table1", "Patient characteristics")
  
## figure captions ------------------------------------
  fig_cap("fig_boxplot", "Boxplot title")
  
## To refer to table/fig in the text ------------------------------------
  # Function to reference table in text
  f.ref <- function(x) {
    stringr::str_extract(tbl_cap(x), "[^:]*")
  }

  # Function to reference figure in text
  f.ref.fig <- function(x) {
    stringr::str_extract(fig_cap(x), "[^:]*")
  }
```
